scope: Deterministic real runtime casts and presentation-only observation; no gameplay, asset, effect or camera-source changes. Historical accepted evidence is reference/control, not candidate acceptance.

clock_contract.schedule: Select phases by observed combat_event and kit.report().casts; record physics ticks and face clocks. Render/sample_time_s may differ by one army tick; never relabel image phase from a filename.

setup.receiver_staging: Same four real lane_minion.gd commanders as existing harness: ally at index0 damaged80, three moon opponents indices1..3; hero damage60. Alignment follows begin geometry, not guessed camera aim. Disable decisions/waves only within isolated staging harness, exactly as existing fixture. Never issue direct damage as proof of an arrow hit.
setup.reset_between_takes: Use scene._restart_army and scene.teleport_to through the existing fixture; do not remove cooldown or speed rules.

face_front.freeze: Compute transform at take start; keep fixed for baseline/candidate. Head tracking, if chosen, must be identical and logged for both.

face_three_quarter_right.anchor_status: Mirrored review camera; new review framing, not an existing accepted image

ordinary_player.transform_source: Existing fixture player.yaw/pitch then player._update_camera; no camera source edits

diagnostic_effects_off.method: Snapshot scene.rama_effects.visible; set false in capture harness only; restore exact previous value before ordinary shots
diagnostic_effects_off.note: Node3D visibility only; events, warnings data, runtime effects stepping, damage and clocks remain active. Hidden warning pixels are not gameplay readability evidence.

ordinary_reduced.required_pair: guardian_circle ordinary receiver and expiry; dawn_volley paced-arrow context
ordinary_reduced.restore: Save report().reduced_effects/reduced_motion, restore both; compare unchanged event/receiver timing

projectile_damage.predicate: damage_applied > 0; health_before + shield_before - health_after - shield_after == damage_applied within 1e-5
exclude: image filename containing contact without matching event

step_movement.predicate: contact_position equals accepted movement destination; subsequent player position changes in that direction; no damage/hit claim

guardian_support.predicate: shield_after > shield_before on entry OR healing_applied > 0 with health_after > health_before on later tick

compact_continuous_take.ordinary_context_camera: ordinary_player for its separate matched take

preroll.method: player.rama_face.reset("round2_capture_start") before natural normal-update preroll only; allow player._update_rama_motion to be sole updater

staged_alternate.method: While SceneTree paused, reset face then call the same public rama_face.update_facial(1.0/60.0,{alive:true,paused:false,effort:0.0})181 times; do not call private _publish or set mesh weights/clocks
staged_alternate.preparation_scope: Staged facial-clock preparation only; world_advanced=false; not naturally elapsed gameplay
staged_alternate.continuous_take: Unpause and use only normal player update for all36 capture frames; never double-update face

preroll.note: Record actual face report. If draw scheduling cannot land on181 ticks, shift start to an observed clock that samples [3.205,3.230] at30Hz. Never label an unsampled near closure as endpoint.

compact_continuous_take.frame_convention: At local time0 before frame0 advance, issue first command. Rendered frames index0..35 are after2,4,...72 physics ticks. Commands at before_frame15 and24 occur after30 and48 physics ticks. Frame sample time=(index+1)/30.

commands.require: accepted=true; previous Kodanda authority recovery has occurred
true; event kind=cancel matches cancel_cast, reason=round2_face_probe; no release/impact for cancel_cast

blink.combined_expression: max(blink, smoothed_effort*.14), left/right equal; effort target1 during windup/hold, .35 during recovery,0 otherwise; not separate brow/jaw/gaze morphs

required_outcomes: At least one left/right published weight=1 within1e-6
Kodanda begin/release/recovery; target-hit claim only if real damage receipt observed
Piercing begin/cancel with zero release/impact/receipts for that cast
After cancel+.16s motion stage none/action empty and aim/effort return continuously
No pause/reset/camera toggle within continuous take
compact_continuous_take.scope_limit: The36-frame sequence covers natural blink plus real action/cancel, not all five abilities, full guardian expiry, defeat, user-key delivery or crowded combat. Other action fixtures remain separate sparse samples.

checks: No eye penetration, face/body boundary cracks or neck discontinuity on adjacent blink/draw/recoil/cancel frames
Preserve full/half morph names and ordering; no manual eyelid publish bypass
Numerically probe pause/reset/teleport and combined blink/effort separately; reset must restore blink_index0/clock0/weights0
No facial fixture closes pre-existing rapid-reversal body defect

minimal_round2_capture_request.five_action_original_scope: One live-runtime late-windup face/neck original for each existing ability. Other event/receiver/reduced/expiry anchors are source-pinned follow-on fixtures; do not claim their new rendering from these five images.
